KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_IMPACTGRENADE_SMALL: A grenade that detonates on impact, dealing explosive damage in a small radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SMOKEGRENADE: A grenade that creates a lingering smoke cloud on impact, blocking visibility from ARC and other Raiders.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_STAMINADOTGRENADE: A grenade that emits a lingering toxic cloud on impact, draining the stamina of any Raiders within its area of effect.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DOTGRENADE: A grenade that detonates on impact, covering an area in fire that deals damage over time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TAGGINGGRENADE: A grenade that detonates after a delay, tagging Raiders and ARC enemies in an area, allowing you to briefly track their location.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BASICSTICKYGRENADE: A grenade that sticks to surfaces, dealing explosive damage after a short delay.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_STICKYREMOTEGRENADE: A remote-detonated grenade that can stick to surfaces and ARC, dealing explosive damage when triggered.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_THROWABLEDECOY: A noisy device that sticks to surfaces, distracting nearby ARC machines and drawing their fire.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_HEGRENADE: A grenade that detonates after a delay, dealing explosive damage in its radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SCATTERMISSILEGRENADE: A grenade that scatters into multiple homing missiles, each one targeting ARC and dealing explosive damage on impact.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_STUNGRENADE: A grenade that detonates after a delay, stunning enemies within its radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_GLOWSTICK: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_HOMINGMISSILEGRENADE: A homing grenade that targets a single nearby ARC dealing explosive damage on impact.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TRAILBLAZER: A grenade that emits a trail of flammable gas along its path, causing an explosive chain reaction when it ignites.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SMOKEGRENADE_SMALL: A grenade that pops a thick but small smoke cloud on impact, blocking visibility from ARC and other Raiders.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_SHRAPNELGRENADE: A makeshift fuze grenade that bursts into razor-sharp fragments upon detonation.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SNOWBALL: A compact snowball fashioned out of the most malleable and aerodynamic snow.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SNOWBALL_ROCK: A heavier "snowball" for the Raiders who don't play nice.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LURE_FIRECRACKER: A device that sparks and pops in a pleasant manner.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_CRASHPAD: A throwable emergency landing device, to soften some heavy landings.
